During your treasure hunts, you may encounter a portal to the mysterious Vault Oneiron.

In its midst lies the hypnoslot machine, programmed to invoke hordes of monsters based on the visions it reveals to its guests.

The hypnoslot machine can be played up to five times. The type of summoning it performs is determined by the results displayed on the three outrunner screens at the end of a spin. The grander the result, the greater the rewards.

Spinning the hypnoslots may result in a <UIForeground>F201FA</UIForeground><UIGlow>F201FB</UIGlow>lesser notion<UIGlow>01</UIGlow><UIForeground>01</UIForeground>, a <UIForeground>F201FA</UIForeground><UIGlow>F201FB</UIGlow>greater fancy<UIGlow>01</UIGlow><UIForeground>01</UIForeground>, or an <UIForeground>F201FA</UIForeground><UIGlow>F201FB</UIGlow>elder imagining<UIGlow>01</UIGlow><UIForeground>01</UIForeground>.

Should you roll three broken diamonds, however, know that your luck has run out, and you will be forcibly expelled from Vault Oneiron.
Rumor also has it that the hypnoslot machine may reveal its most grandiose visions to a lucky few... May the hands of fate guide you and your companions to fortunes untold!

You have obtained a tuft of <UIForeground>F201F4</UIForeground><UIGlow>F201F5</UIGlow>phoenix down<UIGlow>01</UIGlow><UIForeground>01</UIForeground>.

It can be used to revive an incapacitated player.

A tuft of phoenix down may prove beneficial when delving into dungeons and other activities with a party. 

Should party members with the ability to resurrect be downed, a tuft may be used to revive them, allowing your party to recover from a precarious situation.
